description: This file defines a PHP interface 'CapableViewController' within the OrangeHRM project, specifying a contract for controllers to determine capability based on a request.

classes.name: CapableViewController
classes.description: An interface that mandates implementing an 'isCapable' method to evaluate if a view controller can handle a specific request.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Determines if the controller is capable of handling the request, returning true or false.
